EmailConfirmation.Title: Welcome to Trip Radar! 🌍
EmailConfirmation.Message: We're excited to have you join our travel community! To get started and unlock all features, please verify your email address.
EmailConfirmation.SecondaryMessage: Once verified, you'll be able to:
Features: 🌍 Organize all your trips in one place
✈️ Explore flights, accommodations, events, and other travel essentials
🔔 Get personalized travel recommendations
EmailConfirmation.ExpiryInfo: ⏰ This verification link expires in 24 hours
EmailConfirmation.IgnoreText: Didn't create an account? No worries - just ignore this email and no account will be created.

PasswordReset.Title: Reset Your Password 🗝️
PasswordReset.Message: We received a request to reset your Trip Radar account password. Click the button below to create a new password.
Features: 🔒 This link can only be used once
⏱️ It expires in 1 hour for security
🌐 You can only reset from this email address
💻 Works on any device or browser
PasswordReset.ExpiryInfo: ⏰ This reset link expires in 1 hour
PasswordReset.IgnoreText: If you didn't request this password reset, please ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged and your account stays secure.

SubscriptionCancellation.Title: We're Sorry to See You Go 😢
SubscriptionCancellation.Message: We noticed you've canceled your subscription. We'd love to hear your feedback to help us improve our service.
SubscriptionCancellation.MessageWithReason: We noticed you've canceled your subscription. You mentioned: "{0}". We'd love to hear more about your experience.
SubscriptionCancellation.SecondaryMessage: Your subscription has been successfully canceled. Here's what happens next:
Features: ⏰ Your subscription will remain active until the end of your current billing period
💳 No further charges will be made to your account
📊 Your data will be securely stored for 30 days in case you change your mind
🔄 You can resubscribe at any time to regain full access
📧 We'll send you a final summary of your usage before the cancellation takes effect
SubscriptionCancellation.ExpiryInfo: 💝 We truly value your feedback - it helps us improve!
SubscriptionCancellation.IgnoreText: If you didn't cancel your subscription, please contact our support team immediately at support@tripradar.io.

SubscriptionCreated.Title: Welcome to Your New Subscription! 🎉
SubscriptionCreated.Message: Congratulations! Your {0} subscription has been successfully activated. You now have access to all premium features to enhance your travel planning experience.
SubscriptionCreated.FeaturesAccess: ✨ Full access to premium travel features
SubscriptionCreated.ExpiryInfo: 🎯 Start exploring your new premium features today!
SubscriptionCreated.IgnoreText: If you didn't subscribe to this plan, please contact our support team immediately at support@tripradar.io.

SubscriptionUpgraded.Title: Subscription Upgraded Successfully! ⬆️
SubscriptionUpgraded.Message: Great choice! Your subscription has been successfully upgraded from {0} to {1}. You now have access to even more powerful travel planning features.
SubscriptionUpgraded.ExpiryInfo: 🚀 Your new features are active immediately!
SubscriptionUpgraded.IgnoreText: If you didn't upgrade your subscription, please contact our support team immediately at support@tripradar.io.

SubscriptionDowngraded.Title: Subscription Plan Changed ⬇️
SubscriptionDowngraded.Message: Your subscription has been successfully changed from {0} to {1}. The changes will take effect on {2}.
SubscriptionDowngraded.IgnoreText: If you didn't make this change, please contact our support team immediately at support@tripradar.io.

RefundProcessed.Title: Refund Processed Successfully 💰
RefundProcessed.Message: Your refund request has been successfully processed. The amount of {0} will be credited back to your original payment method.
RefundProcessed.ExpiryInfo: ⏱️ Please allow 3-5 business days for the refund to appear in your account
RefundProcessed.IgnoreText: If you didn't request this refund, please contact our support team immediately at support@tripradar.io.

SubscriptionDowngradeScheduled.Title: Subscription Downgrade Scheduled ⏰
SubscriptionDowngradeScheduled.Message: Your subscription will be changed from {0} to {1} on {2}. Until then, you'll continue to enjoy all the benefits of your current plan.
SubscriptionDowngradeScheduled.SecondaryMessage: Here's what you need to know:
SubscriptionDowngradeScheduled.change_notice: 🔄 You can cancel or modify this change anytime before the effective date
SubscriptionDowngradeScheduled.IgnoreText: If you didn't schedule this change, please contact our support team immediately at support@tripradar.io.

PaymentMethodUpdated.Title: Payment Method Updated 💳
PaymentMethodUpdated.Message: Your payment method has been successfully updated. This change will be used for all future billing cycles.
PaymentMethodUpdated.FeaturesEncrypted: 🔒 All payment information is securely encrypted
PaymentMethodUpdated.FeaturesFutureBilling: 💳 Changes apply to future billing cycles
PaymentMethodUpdated.FeaturesNotifications: 📧 You'll receive billing notifications to this email
PaymentMethodUpdated.ExpiryInfo: 🔐 Your payment information is securely stored and encrypted
PaymentMethodUpdated.IgnoreText: If you didn't update your payment method, please contact our support team immediately at support@tripradar.io.

Lifecycle.Title: TripRadar Planning Update
Lifecycle.Message: You have a new planning update in TripRadar.
Features: Open your latest trip context.
Review updated plan details.
Save your next decision.
Lifecycle.ExpiryInfo: You are receiving this email because of recent account activity.
Lifecycle.IgnoreText: If this update wasn't expected, contact support at support@tripradar.io.

ActivationDay0.Subject: Welcome to TripRadar: your first plan starts here
ActivationDay0.Heading: Your account is ready. Build your first trip in minutes
ActivationDay0.Message: You're activated. Open your profile, create one trip vault, then run your first planning request.
ActivationDay0.SecondaryMessage: You are receiving this because your account was recently activated.
Features: Create one trip vault with destination and budget constraints.
Run one request and compare route options before booking.
Save the final choice so your next trip starts faster.

ActivationDay1.Subject: Day 1 check-in: lock your planning workflow
ActivationDay1.Heading: Keep planning decisions in one Telegram-native flow
ActivationDay1.Message: Most users get better outcomes when they keep budget assumptions and route decisions in one place.
ActivationDay1.SecondaryMessage: This is your Day 1 activation checklist.
Features: Use one source of truth for assumptions and final picks.
Compare at least two route options before confirming.
Store your final plan in a reusable vault.

ActivationDay3.Subject: Day 3 tune-up: improve speed and budget control
ActivationDay3.Heading: Refine your process after your first plans
ActivationDay3.Message: After a few requests, adjust your constraints so TripRadar can return stronger tradeoffs faster.
ActivationDay3.SecondaryMessage: This is your Day 3 optimization nudge.
Features: Tighten budget ranges and non-negotiable preferences.
Reuse your best-performing vault template.
Document what changed after booking for future planning.

TelegramConnectNudge.Subject: Finish setup: connect Telegram to start planning
TelegramConnectNudge.Heading: One step left: connect Telegram
TelegramConnectNudge.Message: Your signup is complete. Connect Telegram to unlock planning and keep your trip context synced.
TelegramConnectNudge.SecondaryMessage: Reminder for users who completed signup but did not connect Telegram.
Features: Open the activation page and authorize Telegram.
Run your first trip request after connection.
Save your first trip to start your reusable vault.

WeeklyWinBack.Subject: We saved your planning context. Ready for the next trip?
WeeklyWinBack.Heading: Come back to your trip vault
WeeklyWinBack.Message: Your previous planning context is still available. Resume where you left off and update only what changed.
WeeklyWinBack.SecondaryMessage: Win-back reminder for users inactive in the last 7 days.
Features: Re-open your latest vault and update dates or budget limits.
Compare updated options in one request.
Save the final decision for your next cycle.
